exact_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Blackbeard roster owner.
Primary request: Create ONE original portrait of Blackbeard following the project's own accepted miniature design just shown in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-blackbeard-codex/design/blackbeard-front.png. Use it as the identity, craftsmanship and palette reference, not as a source to crop. Preserve its stern weathered broad face, dark eyes, black braided beard with red ties, brass-trimmed black tricorn, red bandanna and dark red coat. This is the captain himself, not Seadog.
Scene/backdrop: plain uniform charcoal gray, empty.
Subject: one mature pirate captain with a powerful sculpted brow and nose, thick black moustache, long black beard divided into substantial sculpted braids, tiny brass braid cuffs and restrained scarlet ribbon ties. Black tricorn with worn brass edging, crimson bandanna beneath it, short scarf tails near the side of the head. Muted oxblood coat, warm ivory shirt and brown leather diagonal bandolier visible at the upper chest, with only a small suggestion of the accepted flintlock fittings low on the chest. Calm formidable expression, both eyes unobstructed and readable.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted collectible tabletop MINIATURE craftsmanship. Clearly sculpted resin-like locks, coherent painted facial planes, fine restrained brush texture, matte worn cloth and leather, controlled brass highlights. Original game-character bust illustration/render, no photographic human avatar or actor likeness.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered head and shoulders plus upper chest, nearly frontal with only slight natural turn. Full100 composition: use the entire square as the intended future circular crop, no zoom and no tight face crop. ENTIRE tricorn including every corner and crown, whole beard and its ribbon ends visible with generous charcoal margins. Leave about 18 percent clear headroom over the hat; fit hat width inside central 64 percent of the canvas and beard tip above 82 percent canvas height. Eye line around 43 percent height. Head and headgear comfortably fit inside an imaginary centered circle of diameter 100 percent of the square side. Shoulders may taper into the bottom corners. No hands, sabre, pedestal or props beside the face.
Lighting/mood: soft warm-neutral studio key and gentle fill making both eyes clear; strong readable forms, no haze or special effects.
Color palette: accepted coat red #7A1F1F, pitch black #1E1C1C, brass #B08A3E, scarlet ribbon #C8322A, natural warm weathered skin and muted ivory shirt.
Constraints: one original character only; preserve the project's accepted identity and miniature style. Whole head and headgear; no top or side clipping. No text, letters, logos, watermark, frame, badge, medallion, circular mask, UI layout, cards, collage, commercial scan, photography, added eye patch or fantasy glow.

reference_use: Own accepted 1a design opened through view_image immediately before preflight/generation, then described in prompt as context reference. No referenced_image_paths or num_last_images_to_include arguments; this was new source generation, not an edit/crop. No commercial or avatar images opened.

output.source_pixel_processing: none; no resize, crop, retouch, recolor or recompression of original/selected PNG

diagnostic_previews.crop: full100; centered circle diameter 100% of square side, zero zoom
diagnostic_previews.method: Lanczos resampling of entire square; antialiased circular diagnostic mask on light-gray matte. 320 grayscale also provided. These derivative review images do not replace or modify source PNGs.
diagnostic_previews.inspection: Selected saved PNG and full100-review-sheet.png opened with view_image; 80/40 viewed at native tile sizes within sheet. Runtime widget not tested.

self_review.identity: Stern broad pirate face, strong dark brows, black moustache and braided black beard, scarlet ties, brass-edged tricorn and oxblood coat preserve the accepted project design. Slight facial refinement and larger ornamental hat edging are generated interpretation, not a pixel-identical face. No Seadog substitution.
self_review.craftsmanship: Sculpted hair and braid masses, painted worn cloth/leather and controlled brass read as premium miniature bust art. Skin has fine realistic surface texture; physical resin provenance is not claimed.
self_review.background: Plain charcoal with a slight tonal gradient, no scenery, lettering, UI, frame or watermark seen. Not numerically uniform.
self_review.source_framing: Whole hat corners/crown, scarf ends and beard visible. Outer coat and upper chest terminate at square edges as expected for a bust. Actual upper headroom visually about 4%, less than requested 18%; eye line around 33%, higher than requested 43%. No actual head/headgear clipping; one correction was reserved only for actual clipping or identity failure and was not used.
self_review.circular_full100: Centered circle at diameter 100% of square: whole tricorn, face, scarf ends and beard remain inside; lower coat corners, bandolier and pistol hints are partly removed. Crown is close to upper arc, leaving little tolerance for a tighter future crop or border. Keep full100; no zoom.
self_review.native_80: Hat, beard, coat and face remain recognizable; braid ties are color accents and individual eyes are small.
self_review.native_40: Broad pirate silhouette and facial light/dark read; precise eye color, small brass details and individual braids do not reliably resolve. Not proof of character identity to an unfamiliar viewer.
limits: Less top breathing room than the requested generous composition.
Fine facial/eye/braid detail collapses at 40 px.
Lower bandolier and coat are partly cut by full100 circle.
No runtime widget, DPI, interaction state or independent review tested.

scope: Manual files only inside this assigned new character subfolder. Built-in image tool automatic output left at default Codex path. No git mutation, shared/package-root file edits, registry/ledger/code changes, imports, paid external calls or subagents.
processes: All shell, Python and read-only psql commands finished; no background process or service was started.
